announcement_body_description: Supporting line shown next to the heading
announcement_heading_description: Short bold heading, e.g. New Flux version available
announcement_link_text_description: Text of the link at the end of the banner, e.g. Read the release notes
article_sharing_description: Show social media sharing on article
articles_in_section_description: Show sidebar of articles in section
background_color_description: Background color of your Help Center
brand_color_description: Brand color for major navigational elements
brand_text_color_description: Brand color for hover and active states
card_background_color_description: Fill colour for panels and cards. Keep this lighter than the page background so they stand out
community_background_image_description: Hero image on the community topics page
community_image_description: Image for the community section on the home page
favicon_description: Icon displayed in the address bar of your browser
follow_article_description: Users can follow a specific article
follow_post_description: Users can follow a specific post
follow_section_description: Users can follow a specific section
follow_topic_description: Users can follow a specific topic
homepage_background_image_description: Hero image on the home page
hover_link_color_description: Text color for the hover state of link elements
post_sharing_description: Show social media sharing on post
product_field_id_description: ID of the ticket field holding the product, used to tag each ticket row
recent_activity_description: Show recent activity on home page
resources_column_title_description: Heading shown above this column's links
resources_heading_description: Heading above both columns of links, e.g. Useful links
resources_link1_url_description: Where link 1 points. Leave blank to hide this link
resources_link2_url_description: Where link 2 points. Leave blank to hide this link
resources_link3_url_description: Where link 3 points. Leave blank to hide this link
resources_link4_url_description: Where link 4 points. Leave blank to hide this link
scoped_community_search_description: Search results are confined to the topic the user is in
scoped_knowledge_base_search_description: Search results are confined to the category the user is in
service_catalog_hero_image_description: Hero image on the service catalog page
severity_notice_body_description: Text after the phone number. The number itself comes from the setting below, so it is not repeated here
severity_notice_heading_description: Bold heading on the notice, e.g. Critical issue?
show_announcement_description: Show the announcement banner at the top of the home page
show_brand_name_description: Display the Help Center name next to the logo
show_resources_description: Show the project resources links on the home page
show_severity_one_notice_description: Show the Severity 1 phone-first notice on the home page
show_suggested_articles_in_new_request_f: Show suggested articles on new request form
support_phone_description: Phone number shown in the Severity 1 notice
text_color_description: Text color for body and heading elements
visited_link_color_description: Text color for visited link elements
